name: forgets
description: An independent agentic software factory learning project; M0 foundation only.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @forgets/contracts && npm run build -w @forgets/core && npm run build -w @forgets/agents && npm run build -w @forgets/persistence
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration -w @forgets/persistence
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
